A tree hydrated but some attributes of the server rendered HTML didn't match the client properties. This won't be patched up. This can happen if a SSR-ed Client Component used:

- A server/client branch `if (typeof window !== 'undefined')`.
- Variable input such as `Date.now()` or `Math.random()` which changes each time it's called.
- Date formatting in a user's locale which doesn't match the server.
- External changing data without sending a snapshot of it along with the HTML.
- Invalid HTML tag nesting.

It can also happen if the client has a browser extension installed which messes with the HTML before React loaded.

mainEntity.name: Can I convert PDF files online with PDFRoot?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. PDFRoot includes PDF conversion tools such as PDF to Word, PDF to Excel, PDF to PowerPoint, Word to PDF, JPG to PDF, and PDF to JPG.

mainEntity.name: How do I resize an image to exact KB?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open Resize Image to Exact KB, upload your photo or signature, enter the target size such as 20KB, 50KB, or 100KB, and download the optimized file.

mainEntity.name: Can I resize SSC signatures online?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. PDFRoot provides an SSC Signature Resize Tool for candidates who need JPG/JPEG signatures sized between 10KB and 20KB.

mainEntity.name: Can I resize signatures for RRB railway forms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The RRB Signature Resize tool helps prepare JPG/JPEG signatures for railway recruitment applications.

mainEntity.name: Does PDFRoot include a passport photo maker?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Passport Photo Maker helps prepare official-style photos for forms, admissions, applications, and document uploads.

mainEntity.name: How do I compress a PDF online?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose Compress PDF, upload your document, let PDFRoot reduce the file size, and download the compressed PDF for email or portal upload.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions
Can I convert PDF files online with PDFRoot?

Yes. PDFRoot includes PDF conversion tools such as PDF to Word, PDF to Excel, PDF to PowerPoint, Word to PDF, JPG to PDF, and PDF to JPG.

How do I resize an image to exact KB?

Open Resize Image to Exact KB, upload your photo or signature, enter the target size such as 20KB, 50KB, or 100KB, and download the optimized file.

Can I resize SSC signatures online?

Yes. PDFRoot provides an SSC Signature Resize Tool for candidates who need JPG/JPEG signatures sized between 10KB and 20KB.

Can I resize signatures for RRB railway forms?

Yes. The RRB Signature Resize tool helps prepare JPG/JPEG signatures for railway recruitment applications.

Does PDFRoot include a passport photo maker?

Yes. Passport Photo Maker helps prepare official-style photos for forms, admissions, applications, and document uploads.

How do I compress a PDF online?

Choose Compress PDF, upload your document, let PDFRoot reduce the file size, and download the compressed PDF for email or portal upload.
